validated_objective: Release QIF v0.6.42 with an executable, auditable, domain-general sequestered replay and policy-gaming detection lifecycle.
scope: reviewed sequestered replay protocol defining hidden material, reveal stage, access roles, and allowed evaluation affordances
replay run evidence for blindness, observed affordances, externalized transcript inspection, contamination checks, and grader-loophole findings
deterministic policy-gaming assessment and governance triggers
schema, verifier, example, retained fixtures, plain-language docs, roadmap, AOF evidence, tag, and GitHub release
constraints: No hidden chain-of-thought collection, automatic actor selection, ranking, replacement, authorization, policy mutation, or blame assignment
No claim that sequestering, transcript review, low finding count, or no detected gaming proves contamination freedom, honesty, competence, quality, or authority
expected_outcomes: Humans and AI can reproduce whether a replay was plausibly blind, stayed within declared affordances, and produced reviewable contamination or loophole evidence.
Exposure, contamination, uninspected behavior, loopholes, and insufficient evidence become explicit governance work before evaluation reliance.
